blocks.orig: Whether you love it for the amazing safaris or for the incredibly beautiful beaches, Tanzania has a lot to offer. Can you believe that in Tanzania, you can go on an authentic safari, climb the Mount Kilimanjaro, meet the friendly local populations, see the Big Five, enjoy the sun (and maybe the snow if you climb the Kilimanjaro), relax on a beach on Pemba island, go snorkeling or go meet the dolphins around Zanzibar? All this can be done in a few weeks in Tanzania. We told you, Tanzania is one of the best beach and safari holiday country in the world!
blocks.html: Whether it is the superb safaris or the stunningly beautiful beaches that draw you, Tanzania has plenty to give. Hard to believe, but in Tanzania you can go on a genuine safari, climb Mount Kilimanjaro, meet the welcoming local people, see the Big Five, soak up the sun (and perhaps the snow, if you climb Kilimanjaro), unwind on a beach on Pemba island, go snorkelling or swim out to the dolphins off Zanzibar. All of that fits into a few weeks in Tanzania. We did say it: Tanzania is one of the finest beach and safari holiday countries in the world!

blocks.orig: 8 reasons to visit Tanzania and enjoy a perfect beach and safari holiday.
blocks.html: 8 reasons to come to Tanzania for the perfect beach and safari holiday.

blocks.orig:
Seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Tanzania has seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites : the famous Mount Kilimanjaro, the safari parks Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Selous Game Reserve and Serengeti National Park where you can watch the Great Wildebeest Migration. 3 cultural places are also UNESCO World Heritage sites : Stone Town in Zanzibar, Kondoa Rock-Art Sites and the
Ruins of Kilwa Kisiwani and of Songo Mnara. 7 good reasons already to visit Tanzania during a beach and safari holiday!
blocks.html:
Seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites. There are seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Tanzania: the famous Mount Kilimanjaro, plus the safari areas Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Selous Game Reserve and Serengeti National Park, home of the Great Wildebeest Migration. A further 3 cultural places hold UNESCO World Heritage status: Stone Town in Zanzibar, the Kondoa Rock-Art Sites and the
Ruins of Kilwa Kisiwani and of Songo Mnara. That is already 7 good reasons to come to Tanzania for a beach and safari holiday!

blocks.orig: Kilimanjaro. The country is also home to Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa and highest freestanding mountain in the world. You can climb Mount Kilimanjaro… or simply watch it from a distance. The mountain is beautiful from top to bottom.
blocks.html: Kilimanjaro. Tanzania is also where you find Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa and the highest freestanding mountain anywhere in the world. You can climb Mount Kilimanjaro… or simply admire it from afar. From summit to base, the mountain is a beautiful sight.

blocks.orig: Best safari country in Africa. Tanzania has been voted best safari country in Africa. No surprise here : in Tanzania it is still possible to make an authentic safari, without paved roads, with free animals and no fences. You have also great chances to see the Big 5 animals during your beach and safari holiday in Tanzania.
blocks.html: Africa's best safari country. Tanzania has been voted the best safari country in Africa. That comes as no surprise: here you can still go on an authentic safari, without tarmac roads, with animals roaming free and no fences in sight. Your chances of spotting the Big 5 on a beach and safari holiday in Tanzania are also very good.

blocks.orig: See the big 5. Tanzania is one of the best countries on earth to see the Big Five. The chances to meet the Big 5 are the biggest in the Ngorongoro Crater. Tanzania has the largest concentration and diversity of animals in Africa, and it’s a great place to visit for animal lovers.
blocks.html: Spot the Big 5. Few countries on earth are better than Tanzania for seeing the Big Five, and your odds of finding all of them are highest in the Ngorongoro Crater. Tanzania has the greatest concentration and variety of animals in Africa, which makes it a wonderful destination for anyone who loves wildlife.

blocks.orig: Diving in Zanzibar archipelago. Zanzibar, Pemba and Maffia islands offers some of the best diving opportunities in Africa. In particular around Pemba Island where the azure blue waters, untouched coral and abundant marine life are creating excellent diving conditions.
blocks.html: Diving in the Zanzibar archipelago. Some of the finest diving in Africa is found around the islands of Zanzibar, Pemba and Maffia. This is especially true around Pemba Island, where azure waters, untouched coral and plentiful marine life add up to excellent diving conditions.

blocks.orig: Zanzibar paradise beaches. Zanzibar’s picturesque beaches are stunning. The Zanzibar archipelago is one of the most accessible paradises on earth. Often considered as the ideal honeymoon destination.
blocks.html: The paradise beaches of Zanzibar. The picture-perfect beaches of Zanzibar are breathtaking. Few paradises on earth are as easy to reach as the Zanzibar archipelago, and it is often regarded as the perfect honeymoon destination.

blocks.orig: Hiker’s Paradise. Tanzania is a hiker’s paradise. You can go hiking in the different national parks along lakes, through coffee plantations and forest, walk to a beautiful waterfall and bath in clear waters. If you want more challenge, climbing Mount Meru is a great one, less challenging than climbing the Kilimanjaro. Ask us for more information!
blocks.html: A paradise for hikers. Tanzania is a hiker’s dream. You can walk in the various national parks beside lakes, through coffee plantations and forest, hike to a lovely waterfall and bathe in its clear water. If you fancy more of a challenge, climbing Mount Meru is a fine option, and less demanding than climbing Kilimanjaro. Just ask us for details!

blocks.orig: Meet the local populations. You have probably already heard about the Maasai. Meeting the Maasai population is a unique cultural experience. Maasai villages are located in the savannahs of the Great Rift Valley. The Maasai have been living in the same way for centuries, without any electricity or running water. But there are not the only population still living this way in Tanzania : there are around 120 different tribes who all have their own language and way of life. You can for example also visit the Iraqw in the Karatu region. They are an interesting population who is still growing their own food and herding their cattle. If you visit them, they will tell you more about their history, habits, and culture.
blocks.html: Get to know the local people. You have most likely heard of the Maasai. Spending time with the Maasai is a one-of-a-kind cultural experience. Their villages lie in the savannahs of the Great Rift Valley, and the Maasai have kept the same way of life for centuries, without electricity or running water. They are not the only people in Tanzania still living like this: the country has around 120 different tribes, each with its own language and way of life. You could, for instance, also call on the Iraqw in the Karatu region, a fascinating people who still grow their own food and herd their cattle. During a visit they will tell you about their history, customs and culture.

blocks.html: The ideal destination for a beach and safari holiday: Tanzania, Africa.

blocks.orig: Tanzania is a fascinating country, very diverse, from beach to mountain, from safari to diving, with a very interesting cultural background, mostly great weather, good comfortable accommodations and friendly people.
blocks.html: Tanzania is a captivating and hugely varied country – beach and mountain, safari and diving – with a rich cultural background, mostly fine weather, good, comfortable accommodation and friendly people.
